facts.action: 腐地暴走追人（spreading. Fast. Almost as if chasing）中喊 STOP 返身救村
只能选一个村救（Guilt），罩 Ravagen dome
facts.verbatim: Guilt hit her hard at the decision, but she had no other option.

facts.action: 找不到入口还吸食盾之力（反向吸取她的魔法）
facts.verbatim: it was also feeding off it. Taking its power. Draining her.

经 soul-link 供力续她之命（叮嘱别再给——还要运人）
facts.verbatim: A strong rush of power flooded her system, the soul-link humming brightly

facts.action: 返回战场，隔盾点头后入内、悬浮把村民搬上双龙
facts.verbatim: Half a dozen people floated in the air with a frightened screech.

facts.verbatim: “We stop him by any means necessary.”
